title: Map of Browser Agent Testing tool catalogue
scope: Relevant tools for local web and iOS application testing, grouped by job. This is a dated coverage snapshot, not a claim that every testing product is included.

evidence_states.benchmarked: Repeated locally against the shared Vaultwealth journeys or faults.
evidence_states.screened: A bounded local probe was completed, but the tool was not fully qualified.
evidence_states.setup-blocked: Setup was checked or attempted, but the Vaultwealth checkout could not support a fair run.
evidence_states.researched-only: Official documentation was reviewed; no local performance claim is made.

tools.name: Playwright
tools.note: Qualified web baseline; fixed assertions and visual comparisons.

tools.name: agent-browser
tools.note: Batch reduced its own login overhead; batch edit failed 0/5.

tools.name: Playwright CLI
tools.note: Login and edit passed 5/5 but were slower than the saved baseline.

tools.name: Puppeteer
tools.note: Chrome and Firefox automation library.

tools.name: Selenium
tools.note: Mature WebDriver ecosystem and broad browser coverage.

tools.name: Cypress
tools.note: Browser E2E runner with optional managed cloud.

tools.name: WebdriverIO
tools.note: WebDriver and DevTools-based browser and mobile automation.

tools.name: Nightwatch
tools.note: Node-based end-to-end browser testing.

tools.name: TestCafe
tools.note: Scripted browser testing without WebDriver.

tools.name: Taiko
tools.note: Readable Chromium automation API; verify project activity before adopting.

tools.name: Jev Ultrafast
tools.cost: Cheap paid selector + local text model
tools.note: Authenticated search passed 5/5; password fields are excluded upstream.

tools.name: Stagehand
tools.note: Cached replay reached 2.201 s median, 4/4; authoring took 25.544 s.

tools.name: Browser Use
tools.note: Worked with local Bonsai but passed 4/5 at 90.730 s among successes.

tools.name: Chrome DevTools MCP
tools.note: Fast diagnostic companion; not a journey executor.

tools.name: Playwright MCP
tools.note: Accessibility-tree browser control for agents.

tools.name: Codex coding agent
tools.note: Stepwise login passed 5/5; the batched instruction arm qualified 0/5.

tools.name: Skyvern
tools.note: Computer-vision and LLM browser workflow platform.

tools.name: LaVague
tools.note: Web-agent framework with browser actions and retrieval.

tools.name: AgentQL
tools.note: Natural-language element and page-data queries.

tools.name: Magnitude
tools.note: Vision-first browser agent; text-only Bonsai is not a fair model.

tools.name: BrowserGym / AgentLab
tools.note: Research environment for reproducible web-agent evaluation.

tools.name: Browser MCP
tools.note: MCP control of an existing browser session.

tools.name: OpenAI computer use
tools.note: General screenshot-and-action computer-use model, not a test oracle.

tools.name: Anthropic computer use
tools.note: General computer-use tool requiring an external execution environment.

tools.name: Browserable
tools.note: Self-hostable agent browser library.

tools.name: Browserbase
tools.note: Managed remote browsers; Stagehand integration is first-party.

tools.name: Browserless
tools.note: Remote Playwright/Puppeteer browser infrastructure.

tools.name: Steel
tools.note: Open-source browser API for agents and apps.

tools.name: Hyperbrowser
tools.note: Managed browsers and agent infrastructure.

tools.name: Anchor Browser
tools.note: Cloud browsers for agents and automation.

tools.name: Vitest browser visual assertions
tools.note: Screenshot matching inside Vitest browser mode.

tools.name: Percy
tools.note: Managed cross-browser visual review.

tools.name: Applitools Eyes
tools.note: Managed visual-AI comparison and review.

tools.name: Chromatic
tools.note: Storybook-oriented component visual testing.

tools.name: Argos
tools.note: Visual and accessibility-tree diffs for pull requests.

tools.name: Lost Pixel
tools.note: Sunsetting; useful comparison history, not a fresh adoption recommendation.

tools.name: BackstopJS
tools.note: Self-hosted browser screenshot regression testing.

tools.name: Loki
tools.note: Storybook screenshot regression testing; verify maintenance before adopting.

tools.name: Maestro
tools.note: Retained iOS saved-flow baseline.

tools.name: AXe
tools.note: Fast warm runs, but cold accessibility and text-entry reliability blocked adoption.

tools.name: XcodeBuildMCP
tools.note: Useful installed-app probe; full save/relaunch journey was not qualified.

tools.name: XCUITest
tools.note: Vaultwealth checkout lacked an app-owned Xcode UI-test target.

tools.name: Detox
tools.note: Vaultwealth checkout lacked Detox configuration and an app-owned target.

tools.name: Appium
tools.note: Cross-platform W3C WebDriver automation; iOS uses the XCUITest driver.

tools.name: Appium MCP
tools.note: Official MCP layer for Appium mobile automation.

tools.name: Patrol
tools.note: Flutter-focused native integration testing.

tools.name: EarlGrey 2
tools.note: Google iOS UI automation integrated with XCUITest.

tools.name: idb
tools.note: Granular simulator and device automation CLI.

tools.name: idb-mcp
tools.note: MCP wrapper around idb for iOS Simulator control.

tools.name: AppleSimulatorUtils
tools.note: Simulator state and permission utilities; prefer simctl where upstream marks overlap deprecated.

tools.name: Ternary Bonsai 2 27B PTQ1_0
tools.note: Text helper passed 25/25; no-thinking median 1.082 s at 7.305 GB sampled peak RSS.

tools.name: Prism llama.cpp
tools.note: Pinned runtime used to serve Bonsai locally.

tools.name: Ollama
tools.note: Convenient local model runtime; not benchmarked in this experiment.

tools.name: MLX LM
tools.note: Apple-silicon local model runtime; not benchmarked here.
